title: Mystic Library Sorcerer
description: A robed sorcerer with dark skin and dreadlocks stands on stone steps within a glowing arched portal, one hand emitting green magical energy. In the foreground, an ornate marble table holds an open book with glowing green serpentine patterns, a smoking red candle, an open chest with a green orb, scattered coins, and various potion bottles.
prompt: A mystical sorcerer with dark skin and dreadlocks wearing ornate blue and gold robes stands inside a glowing arched portal in an ancient library. He gestures with one hand emitting green magic. In the foreground on a marble table sits an open book with glowing green serpentine designs, an open chest containing a green orb, a smoking red candle, potion bottles, and scattered gold coins. The background shows tall bookshelves filled with books and potions under a starry blue arched ceiling with a hanging lantern, highly detailed fantasy scene.
